text:
Lina (CSM): Heads up — Orion Retail just flagged a new cross-border localization team in APAC. They want to onboard a few squads next month. Signals: need private VPC, model pinning, and ~3x current embedding QPS. They mentioned compliance checks for local data residency. :wave:

Sam (CS Ops): Pinged account notes — they're current Dedicated pilot customers in NA, but this is a new org unit. Do we have burst capacity in ap-southeast? :eyes:

Michael (Solutions Eng): Quick take: routing + regional footprint is doable but we'll need a Dedicated pool in ap-southeast or fallback to hosted EU with VPC peering. Also need to confirm model/quantization: what embedding model are they using now?

Ana (AE): They said in the call: `embed-large-v2` (quantized) for search + freshness indexing. Estimated baseline: 8k embeddings/day, expected peak 60k/day after ramp; concurrent QPS peek ~200 during biz hours. Renewal is in 45 days — good upsell opportunity if we move fast. :rocket:

Ben (Product): Noted. If they want model pinning + private control plane + residency, we should surface Dedicated pilot checklist and the Private deployment constraints. Also: capture which evals we need to run for quality regression after quantization.

Devon (Infra): I can check capacity. If they need persistent VPC and dedicated nodes in ap-southeast, we'll need ~2x small GPU workers initially. I'll run a capacity check and post ETA.

Sam (CS Ops): Action items I'm putting in the playbook: 1) Prod-checklist + security questionnaire 2) Provision trial Dedicated pool estimate 3) Run eval set on embed-large-v2 quantized 4) Coordinate compliance docs for regional data handling.

Lina (CSM): Adding contact info: Primary PM is @orion-Liz, infra lead is @orion-ken. They want a kickoff next Wed 10am SGT. Can we target a pilot by the end of next month?

Michael (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a short onboarding plan and pre-flight eval steps. Proposed short snippet for the eval harness we discussed:
```
# eval config snippet
model: embed-large-v2-quantized
batch_size: 64
seq_len: 512
sample_set: localization-core-1k.jsonl
metrics: [cosine_recall@10, latency_p95]
```

Ben (Product): Also push the recommended caching + prefix reuse settings for localization workloads — that can shave costs and keep latency stable. I'll attach the Optimize playbook link.

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder set by Lina (CSM) for 2795016000 (next week) — "Orion APAC kickoff".

Devon (Infra): Capacity check result: small GPU pool available but will require infra change window. ETA for Dedicated pool provisioning: 9 business days if approved today. If we need faster, we can propose EU-hosted fallback (no dedicated VPC) as temporary.

Sam (CS Ops): Noted. Lina, can you confirm they are OK with a staged rollout (EU fallback -> ap-southeast Dedicated)? If yes, I'll prepare quotes for both scenarios and include burst limits.

Lina (CSM): Confirmed on call they'd accept staged. I'm capturing upsell motion for renewal (multi-region plus private). I'll sync with Ana to update contract terms.

Ana (AE): I'll draft an amendment and send preliminary pricing by EOD tomorrow. Also looping legal for data residency clause.

Michael (Solutions Eng): Will upload the eval results to the shared doc after first run. Link I'll use: https://redwood.company/internal/playbooks/onboarding-orion-apac (private)

Sam (CS Ops): Creating internal ticket: CS-6543 (Orion APAC onboarding + Dedicated estimate). Lina, please add the sample eval set and their contact list to the ticket.

Lina (CSM): Added sample set and contacts to CS-6543. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Ben (Product): Quick product ask — can we capture telemetry for geo-routing failovers in the rollout? Would be helpful for post-rollout analysis.

Devon (Infra): Yes, we can add a flag to emit routing diagnostics for the org during pilot (low overhead). I'll include that in the infra change request.

Lina (CSM): Last: Risk note — if Dedicated provisioning slips past renewal, we risk churn or discount pressure. Let's prioritize the 9-day path.

Sam (CS Ops): Agreed. I'm marking this high priority.

ops-bot: CS-6543 updated by Sam (CS Ops) at 2795012380."
